items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Sonny Allen and Walter Pichon, and they call it the Pelican Silvertone

ctx.x: So, when Paul was getting ready to leave the band, they sent for me, you see? In fact, Paul told me, they want me to work with people on the band, because he's going to leave and go make up a band with Sonny Allen and, uh, Sonny Allen and Walter Pichon, and they call it the Pelican Silvertone, obviously.
That's Sonny Allen. That'd be Red Allen.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: what caused me to get into the Piran band was Walter Pichon came at the old place they called the Pelican

ctx.x: They changed name on that band, though. They called it Henry Russell, they called it Silvertone band one time. Yeah, possibly, yeah.

You see, well how them fellas in them days do them things is, just like what caused me to get into the Piran band was Walter Pichon came at the old place they called the Pelican, it was run by the Astoria. The Pelican was located on Grabin' Ramp, which you got a parking lot in there. That's another place used to run, much famous as the Bull, because some nights they'd have four bands that would play up there.
